<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Governance review:</strong> Prime Minister Modi held a direct review of governance and policy implementation with his ministers, notably excluding bureaucrats from the proceedings.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
